Checking by cases: 1R4D = 8·15 = 120, 2R3D = 28·20 = 560, 3R2D = 56·15 = 840, 4R1D = 70·6 = 420. These sum to 1940.

Solution 1 omits the 4R1D and 1R4D cases (1400). Solution 2 omits 1R4D (1820). Solution 3 includes 1R4D but computes 8C1·6C4 as 8·15 = 120 and 2R3D as 560 correctly, yet its sum drops the 4R1D case (1520).
